description: On the red surface there’s a white dustpan near the back, a small white domino tile in the middle, plus a green triangular piece, a blue spoon, a black disk, and a couple of small toy mice. The right hand reaches in from the right toward the domino, pinches and lifts it up, then moves it diagonally up-left and sets it down inside the dustpan before releasing, leaving the dustpan holding the tile.
